title: on-deploy
description: The doftiles deployment orchestrator: verifies the WM-stack binaries, installs the missing ones through per-platform deploy scripts, and provisions the session stack from declarative profiles.

content.heading: on-deploy - the deployment orchestrator
content: on-deploy turns the dotfiles repo into a one-command deployment. It runs inside the doftiles checkout and reads two manifests: wm.requires (the required binaries; the last line names the platform - ubuntu, arch, ... - selecting the <target>.deploy resolver) and deploy.profile (how the graphical session starts).

content.heading: The verbs
content: check - report the requirement state; exit 1 when anything is missing (also --json).

deploy - install every missing binary: resolve the package, show the command, confirm (Enter = yes), run it, then re-verify - a binary still missing after its command fails the run. --yes for non-interactive runs; --dry-run to preview.
provision - platform services per profile: the X server set, the ~/.xinitrc session line, a greetd + tuigreet greeter, the nested stack packages.

snapshot - collect a machine's pre-existing config into doftiles' defaults/ (a stow-shaped package) BEFORE the first deploy overwrites it - the machine's prior state, versioned in git, restorable with one make target.
configure - edit the deploy target and the required-package list from an interactive menu (or --target/--add/--remove flags).

content.heading: The profiles
content: Four session models, co-installable where it makes sense:
wsl - hlwm as a systemd user unit waiting for the Windows-side X server (VcXsrv); provision even checks the Windows partition for VcXsrv and offers a silent install from the SourceForge feed.
nested - hlwm inside an Xvfb framebuffer, shared over VNC and browser noVNC - the temporary profile, additive to a primary one.
xinit - startx runs ~/.xinitrc; no display manager.
greetd - greetd + tuigreet own the console.
A profile declares units (systemd user units, enabled additively) and env overrides (written to ~/.config/doftiles/env, read by the units via EnvironmentFile).

content.heading: Built to not hang, not lie
content: Non-interactive runs abort cleanly demanding --yes instead of blocking on prompts; every install is re-verified; a failed install fails the run. The prompts ride a raw line reader (bun's readline wedges), and the menu works scripted or interactive.
